warnings: *** THIS SHEET DEFINES THE GRAB-RAIL MARKS USED IN THE BATHROOMS -- H1, H2 and H3 -- which A-24 and A-25 use without explaining. *** H1 is the adjustable shower-head slide rail (1.22-1.80 m), H2 an L-shaped shower grab rail (0.42 m, top at 0.80 m), H3 a 1.20 m vertical shower grab rail. Two further rails are detailed without an H mark: the folding pair at the basin and the fixed-plus-folding pair at the WC.

*** THE MARK H4, WHICH A-24 SHOWS AT THE SHOWER BESIDE THE DRAWN WHEELCHAIR, IS NOT DEFINED ON THIS SHEET. *** Nor is the plain H at the WC, unless it is meant to be the WC rail detailed here without a mark. Both remain open; A-29 (รายการสุขภัณฑ์) is the last place they could be defined.

TWO OF THE FIVE RAILS FOLD ('ชนิดพับได้') -- at the basin and on the open side of the WC. That is what lets a wheelchair pull alongside, and it is a materially different (and more expensive) item from a fixed rail in a take-off.
ALL RAILS ARE STAINLESS ø 1 1/2" with some ø 1" secondary members. A-03 asks for ø 3-4 cm; 1 1/2" is 3.8 cm, inside that range.

RAIL HEIGHTS CLUSTER AT 0.80 M -- the H2 top, the basin rails and the WC rails are all at or about 0.80, with the WC also dimensioned at 0.70. That is the seated working height, distinct from the 0.90 m stair and balcony rails.

The WC position is given as a RANGE, '0.26-0.30' from the wall to the centre-line, rather than a single figure -- the only ranged dimension found so far in the set. It accommodates different pan models.
